description: Splunk Enterprise for Windows versions below 10.4.4, 10.2.8, 10.0.11, and 9.4.16 contain a vulnerability where users with the edit_user capability can create multiple accounts that share the same user directory. This occurs due to improper validation of usernames and Windows filesystem behavior that removes trailing periods from directory names, causing distinct usernames to map to the same directory. This can lead to exposure or modification of user-specific configurations and disruption of features relying on separate user directories.
